rationale: The assistant correctly said plastics staying wet is normal and asked the key questions (heat, rinse aid, programme). After the customer answered, it concluded there was no fault and pointed to the real causes: empty rinse aid, Eco 50, and unloading immediately. It suggested filling the rinse aid, trying an extra-dry option or another programme, and waiting before unloading, and it recommended no part or engineer. Minor issues are some confident technical claims, such as the all-in-one rinse aid being used up early, and the extra-dry caveat repeating earlier advice. In the first reply, 'condensation' was asserted for the Serie 4 without model evidence.
